POV: you skipped the packed south beaches and ended up here instead.

Ong Lang beach sits on the quieter west side of Phu Quoc. Fewer crowds. More shade trees. The kind of afternoon where you actually stop checking your phone.

4.1★ across 747 reviews. Not the most famous beach on the island. That's the point.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
